Hi Neha,

Thanks for the quick onboarding call last week. Attached is our standard vendor onboarding form (appstream_onboarding_form.pdf). A few items to flag up front so we can get set in your AP system:

- Our standard payment terms are Net45 by default for contracted services.
- We can offer a 1% early-pay discount if Redwood remits payment within 10 calendar days of invoice.
- We require PO reference on the invoice and an emailed copy to accounts@appstreamlabs.com.

Could you confirm Redwood's PO format and whether Net45 is acceptable? If not, we can discuss a transition cadence (e.g., Net45 for initial quarter then Net30).

Attached: appstream_onboarding_form.pdf (fillable), W9 and bank details to follow in a secure doc after we confirm approach.

Hi all —

Thanks for the context, Susan. Procurement can support a transitional payment cadence. Proposed approach:

1) Initial onboarding period: Net45 for the first 90 days after first invoice (to accommodate your collections cadence).
2) After 90 days, move to Redwood standard Net30 provided SLAs and invoice accuracy remain consistent.
3) Early-pay: we can consider a 1% discount for payment within 10 calendar days. Finance needs this spelled out on the invoice line (e.g., "1.0% PIF if paid within 10 days").

PO and invoicing requirements from Redwood:
- PO template: REDWOOD-PO-YYYY-#### (please ensure the PO number is included in the invoice subject and the "Reference" field).
- Submit invoices to invoices@redwood.ai; copy marissa_cole@redwood.ai for the first two invoices to speed verification.
- For vendor portal setup, we need: completed onboarding form, W9 (US vendors), bank details (voided check or bank letter), and a signed services agreement if applicable.

If AppStream is OK with the terms above, please return the completed form and bank/W9 docs and we'll issue the initial PO within 3 business days of receipt.

Regards,

Dev Patel
Senior Procurement Manager
Redwood Inference
dev.patel@redwood.ai
